name: architecture
title: 架构还原 · 调用链
text: For authorized software architecture reconstruction, identify entrypoints, modules, interfaces and boundaries before deeper decompilation. Trace one behavior end-to-end and record symbol names, addresses, cross-references and uncertainty. Represent observations as a dependency or call graph when supported by real evidence. Distinguish reconstructed behavior from original implementation. Do not run target binaries or modify targets without explicit authorization.
